The answer to "which is the richest state" depends on the metric used. By GDP, California is the richest state, with the largest state GDP of $3.987 trillion [d6], a finding confirmed by multiple sources using composite economic measures [d5][d8]. By median household income, Massachusetts ($99,858) ranks first for 2023 [d4], though New Jersey ($96,346) tops the list based on 2022 U.S. Census Bureau data [d7]. By per capita personal income in 2023, Massachusetts ranks second among all jurisdictions, just behind the District of Columbia (which is not a state) [d2]. In summary, California is the richest by total economic output, while Massachusetts and New Jersey lead in income-based measures of individual wealth [d4][d7][d5].
